professionalSummary.text: Energy analytics analyst with three years of experience analyzing metered energy data for twenty-four commercial buildings under the team's analysis procedure and identifying savings measures with expected savings.
professionalSummary.witness: Energy analytics analyst at a building services company for three years, analysing the metered energy data of twenty-four commercial buildings under the team's analysis procedure and identifying savings measures with their expected savings.

professionalSummary.text: Prepared monthly performance reports for landlords under energy performance contracts, with reports accepted by landlords' facilities managers.
professionalSummary.witness: Prepared the monthly performance report for each landlord under the energy performance contracts, with the reports accepted by the landlords' facilities managers.

professionalSummary.text: Monitored contracted savings against the baseline monthly, raising two shortfalls to the account director, with records in the savings register.
professionalSummary.witness: Monitored the contracted savings against the baseline each month and raised two shortfalls to the account director concerned, recorded in the savings register.

professionalSummary.text: Coordinated measure proposals with site engineers through the measure log, with approvals and contract commitments remaining with the account director, and documented which analyses were the candidate's.
professionalSummary.witness: Coordinated the measure proposals with the site engineers through the measure log; the measure approvals and the contract commitments were the account director's, recorded on each proposal, and the log records which analyses were mine.

professionalSummary.text: Documented limitation sections and hand-over conditions for each measure proposal for site engineers.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the limitation section and the hand-over conditions of each measure proposal for the site engineers.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Work sample: one monthly performance report, two measure proposals with approval records and savings register extract for one quarter, with energy data platform references as verification trail.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: one monthly performance report, two measure proposals with their approval records and the savings register extract for one quarter, with the energy data platform references as a verification trail.

evidence.text: Energy analytics analyst at a building services company for three years, analysing the metered energy data of twenty-four commercial buildings under the team's analysis procedure and identifying savings measures with their expected savings.
Prepared the monthly performance report for each landlord under the energy performance contracts, with the reports accepted by the landlords' facilities managers.
Monitored the contracted savings against the baseline each month and raised two shortfalls to the account director concerned, recorded in the savings register.

Coordinated the measure proposals with the site engineers through the measure log; the measure approvals and the contract commitments were the account director's, recorded on each proposal, and the log records which analyses were mine.
Wrote the limitation section and the hand-over conditions of each measure proposal for the site engineers.
